<thought>We need to find the appropriate retrosynthetic template for the intramolecular Michael cyclization of a chalcone to a flavanone. The previous attempt failed due to incorrect bond format. We'll search the template catalog using the correct bond notation: "6-6" for a C‑C bond and "6-8" for a C‑O bond. We'll keep the same target SMILES and functional group criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(O)C2=CC=CC=C2O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
